rawContent: #UNGA76 comes at a critical time this year, just weeks before #COP26. We know that the impact of climate change exacerbates gender inequality, so it's critical that world leaders focus their attention on the protection of girls' rights in the #ClimateCrisis. @PlanNY_UN https://t.co/9QzR2f0seR

The #ClimateCrisis demands global action & leadership. During crises, girls are 2.5 times more likely to be out of school than boys. This is why gender-transformative education is key to enhancing the participation of girls in climate processes & achieving climate justice.
